behavior: The SessionEnd bridge archives the MEMORY.md handoff block into 10_projects/<project>/sessions/ from a SessionEnd payload, and is a resilient no-op on trivial/missing/empty input. Implementation superseded by CLI-025 (dotf mem session-end); behavior contract unchanged.
The session-end implementation is vet/lint-clean (Go port; the shellcheck of session-handoff.sh retired with the script under CLI-025).
